Title: [JOURNEY] Duplicate permalink вЂ” create general + org-A page, publish both, org-A buyer and anonymous each get their page
Preconditions: Admin with Page Builder publish rights; PageBuilder, Pages and XCMS builds of VCST-6442 (PageBuilder 3.1039.0-pr-179, Pages 3.1011.0-pr-24, XCMS 3.1009.0-pr-28 or later) installed; {{STORE_ID}} is B2B-store with en-US as default language. Every page is created in the case (the permalink is the state under test, never a seeded page); names are AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-<tag>, <unique> from scripts/lib/random-data.ts, all dates are relative to the time of the run. PL = /agent-test-vcst6442-<unique>-<caseid> unless the case says otherwise. Storefront buyer @td(ACME_BUYER.email) (password @td(ACME_BUYER.password)) is a member of organization A on {{STORE_ID}}; the B2B-store storefront redirects anonymous visitors to /sign-in, so the anonymous check runs through xAPI. Pages index lag up to 60 s: poll, never sleep
Steps:
--- LAYER: API (organization A id and the two pages) ---
[AUTH] Obtain an admin Bearer token via POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (user {{ADMIN}}, password from the environment, never typed in the case)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/members/search with {memberType:"Contact", keyword:"@td(ACME_BUYER.email)"}; capture the first organizations[] id of that contact as ORG_A
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/create-group-page with {name:"AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-general", permalink:"<PL>", cultureName:"en-US", storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", visibility:true}; capture id as GEN
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/grouped/publishing/{GEN}?publish=true
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/create-group-page with {name:"AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-org", permalink:"<PL>", cultureName:"en-US", storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", visibility:true, organizationId:"{ORG_A}"}; capture id as ORGP
--- SCREEN: Admin, organization-A page form (Page Builder shell) ---
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/apps/page-builder-shell/?storeId={{STORE_ID}}
[ACT] Open the page AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-org from the Pages list
[WAIT] The UI settles (no spinner, network idle)
[ASSERT] A warning under the Permalink field says other pages use this permalink and lists AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-general; Save is not blocked
[ACT] Click "Publish"
[WAIT] The UI settles (no spinner, network idle)
[ASSERT] The page is Published at once, no confirmation dialog is shown (a general page next to an organization page is not a conflict)
--- LAYER: GraphQL (anonymous visitor, poll up to 60 s) ---
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with {storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", keyword:"<PL>"}; capture the pages[].id of the Published page of group GEN as GEN_DOC (read it again after every publish: the Pages id changes on publish)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with {storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", keyword:"<PL>"}; capture the pages[].id of the Published page of group ORGP as ORG_DOC (read it again after every publish: the Pages id changes on publish)
[GQL] query { slugInfo(permalink:"<PL>" storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}" cultureName:"en-US") { entityInfo { id } } } with no Authorization header
[ASSERT] entityInfo.id equals GEN_DOC
--- SCREEN: Storefront, signed in as @td(ACME_BUYER.email) ---
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] Sign in as @td(ACME_BUYER.email)
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}<PL>
[ASSERT] The page shown is the organization-A page (document title AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-org), not the general page
--- LAYER: GraphQL (org-A buyer) ---
[AUTH] Obtain a Bearer token for @td(ACME_BUYER.email) via POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (bare password grant, no client_id or scope, username @td(ACME_BUYER.email), password @td(ACME_BUYER.password), storeId={{STORE_ID}})
[GQL] the same slugInfo query with the buyer Bearer token
[ASSERT] entityInfo.id equals ORG_DOC
Assertions:
[BLADE] {SPEC} 112407 Admin item 1: creating or saving with an existing permalink is allowed, a warning under the permalink lists the other pages
[STATE] {SPEC} 112407 Admin item 5 (No prompt): a general page next to a page for an organization publishes without a dialog
[DATA] {SPEC} 112407 Frontend item 1: a page for everyone and a page for organization A share a permalink, an anonymous visitor gets the page for everyone
[DOM] {SPEC} 112407 Frontend item 1: a user of organization A gets the organization-A page (document title AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique>-org shown, the general page title absent)
[DATA] {SPEC} same item through slugInfo with the buyer token: the organization page id
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on any screen of the flow
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql or on the page-builder-pages calls
[ADMIN] both pages show Published in the Pages list
Failure_Signals: Org-A buyer is served the general page; anonymous visitor served the organization page; publishing the organization page blocked by a dialog; warning missing under the permalink; storefront renders empty
Cleanup:
[AUTH] Obtain an admin Bearer token via POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (user {{ADMIN}}, password from the environment, never typed in the case)
[HTTP] For every AGENT-TEST-VCST6442-<unique> group this case created: POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/grouped/archive?ids={groupId}; if the archive is refused for a Published group, POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/grouped/publishing/{groupId}?publish=false first, then archive
[VERIFY] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/page-builder-pages/search with {storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", keyword:"agent-test-vcst6442-<unique>"} lists no Draft or Published group
